decisions.statement: An empty agent id names no seat.
A page is a seat by the page type filing it rather than by the folder it sits in.
A seat named is reached by asking the index for that name under the seat type.
No folder a seat's page sits in is written in this code.
A seat's slug is read off its page file name rather than out of the page.
A subagent is answered the page of the seat above that subagent.
A value asked for under a key the table does not name comes back as nothing.
The seat listing is taken once for each call rather than once for each seat.
The moment beside a seat is the modification time of the file with the value beside that seat.
An empty text beside a seat is answered as no value rather than as an empty value.
The mode a seat is running in is written beside that seat on the beat its process key is written.
The pid holding a seat is read out of that seat's process key and nowhere else.
A seat with no process key beside it is held by no pid.

definition: where a seat's page is in akasha and where each of its values sits beside it
